hints.tr: `ax.plot(months, sales, marker="o")` noktalı bir çizgi çiziyor.
hints.en: `ax.plot(months, sales, marker="o")` draws a line with points.

hints.tr:
Çözüm:

```python
months = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr"]
sales = [120, 150, 130, 180]

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
ax.plot(months, sales, marker="o")
ax.set_title("Monthly sales")
ax.set_ylabel("Sales (thousands)")

print(len(ax.lines))
print(ax.lines[0].get_ydata().tolist())
print(ax.get_ylabel())
```
